problem_observed: platform-desktop-app already described itself as the installable product project, but the installed shell runtime did not have a single bundled contract to read before work.

Runtime data boundary and CLI adapter rules existed in separate configs, but there was no deterministic validator that forced a shell boot sequence, enforcement gates, and data accumulation targets to stay connected.
The project structure did not explicitly list a shell-readable runtime contract folder.

large_scope_decomposition.merge_gate: runtime contract check, config contract check, readiness/test, Rust check, omission/resource/evaluate-work

accepted_decisions: Create `platform-desktop-app/runtime-contracts/` as the project-owned shell-readable contract folder.
Bundle the contract and bootstrap docs as Tauri resources.
Add `get_installer_shell_runtime_contract` to the Rust command surface.
Add `scripts/check-runtime-contract.mjs` and include it in the default check chain.
Keep external AI CLIs as guest adapters and keep missing CLI behavior as `capability_missing`.
rejected_options: Move shared governance folders into platform-desktop-app.
Install or bundle a new external shell sidecar in this turn.
Let the UI infer shell behavior from scattered docs without a contract validator.
validation_gate: Contract check, config contract, platform-desktop-app test/check, Rust check, and close-out evaluators must pass.
